title: Number of Atoms
problemStatement: Given a valid chemical formula, return the count of each atom in lexicographical order. Rules: Element names begin with an uppercase letter and may be followed by lowercase letters. A number following an element or a closing parenthesis indicates its multiplicity. Parentheses may be nested. Output the formula in its canonical form.
input: A string representing the chemical formula.
output: A string representing the canonical atom count.
